text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The trio consisting of Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning Ticket has been dubbed "BNW" and is garnering attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, they compete in the Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each of them has their own strong motivation to win, so this is bound to be an exciting race!
